profile.name: David Heffler

about: Fullstack software engineer with 4+ years of professional experience, currently balancing entrepreneurship with academics. Outside of work and school, I enjoy photography, hiking, chess, Tetris, rhythm games, and maintaining my cactus garden.

experience.title: Founder
experience.description: Building application-layer bot intelligence — detects autonomous behavior, scores entities over time, and responds automatically.
bullets: Designed and shipped a real-time signal ingestion pipeline using Redis Streams with in-process consumer workers.

Developed an open source SDK (@usevane/core, @usevane/next, @usevane/cli, @usevane/mcp) for 30-second installs via CLI scaffolding.
Implemented AI-operated interfaces: dashboard copilot, MCP server for editor integration, and natural language rule authoring.

experience.title: Founder & Technical Consultant
experience.description: Founded a consultancy delivering fullstack, production-grade systems for international clients with fast iterations and reliable operations.
bullets: Architected and shipped e-commerce and B2C platforms using TypeScript, Next.js, and MongoDB.
Implemented CI/CD with Docker, Vercel, and Coolify; standardized deploy workflows, rollbacks, and environment parity.
Established operational readiness: uptime monitoring, structured logs, backups, SSL/TLS, and CDN caching.
Partnered directly with stakeholders to scope clear milestones and deliver on aggressive timelines.

Designed microservice APIs and message-driven data pipelines; improved data integrity and throughput.
Reduced ingestion latency and improved observability with structured logs and metrics.
Collaborated on data modeling and storage strategies balancing cost, speed, and retention requirements.
